Metadata.title: Bruno Werner, fullstack developer
Metadata.description: Fullstack developer in Joinville, Brazil. I build the systems that connect sales, billing and logistics: B2B portals, ERP and CRM integrations and data dashboards.

Hero.h1: Bruno Werner, fullstack developer for integrations, ERP and events
Hero.name: Bruno Werner
Hero.pitch: I make systems <mark>talk</mark> without losing an order.
Hero.lede: ERP, CRM, carriers and payments exchanging data with queues, retries, idempotency and logs a person can read. Today I build this at Alva Personal Care.
